description: This PHP class defines a controller called EmployeeCsvImportSampleAttachmentController responsible for generating and serving a CSV file template related to employee data import. It extends an abstract file controller and handles HTTP requests to produce a CSV with headers for employee information.

classes.name: EmployeeCsvImportSampleAttachmentController
classes.description: A controller class that handles HTTP requests to generate and deliver a CSV template for employee data import. It sets appropriate headers and content to facilitate file download.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming request, prepares the CSV content string with employee data headers, sets proper HTTP response headers for CSV file download, and returns the response object.
